name: Survive Glass Bridge For Brainrots!
desc:
Welcome to Survive Glass Bridge For Brainrots!

😱 Jump across a glass bridge where every jump is a 50/50!
🤑 Grab brainrots and bring them back to your plot!
💵 Upgrade your Brainrots to increase earnings!
🏗️ Improve your base to unlock more storage slots!
💤 Earn cash even while offline!

👍 Like, favourite and follow if you enjoy the game!
